en.html:
Shishiku"Your Highness Kuniuji. Lady Hanae. The appointed hour is almost here."
Kuniuji"..."
Hanae"..."
Shishiku"Kindly make yourselves ready."
Kuniuji"Hm..."
Kuniuji"..."
Kuniuji"No, but... Shishiku."
Shishiku"Your Highness. This engagement's purpose has been explained. Not once. Several times already."
Shishiku"For the recovery of Kamakura, it is a step that cannot be avoided."
Kuniuji"That... I understand. I understand, but—"
Shishiku"Understanding is there? Then obedience may follow. You were born to bear the destiny of Rokuhara—of Yamato itself."
Shishiku"Your personal wishes, kindly discard. Whatever the decision, only the country's interests require consideration. Your wishes do not have a seat at this table."
Kuniuji"————"
Court Lady"Sh-Shishiku sir! This is too much! You cannot speak so!"
Shishiku"...Too much? Which part is too much?"
Shishiku"Reality only, madam. I am explaining reality. Or has one false thing come out of my mouth? Even one small falsehood?"

Kuniuji"Wa—wait!"
Shishiku"Your Highness."
Kuniuji"...!"
Shishiku"Once again, Your Highness. Reality appears to require repetition."
Shishiku"Kuniuji Ashikaga has no value whatsoever. The value is in the offices: Head of the Minamoto. Marshal of the Dragon Army. Senior Third Rank, Commander of the Six Guards. The chair has value, Your Highness."
Shishiku"...Understood? Whatever you do from now on, kindly remember which part of you is valuable."
Kuniuji".................."
Shishiku"Your Highness. Your command, please."
Kuniuji"...I shall go and prepare. Wait a while."
Shishiku"Yes, Your Highness!"

Hanae"..."
Shishiku"Lady Hanae. The same request applies to you."
Hanae"..."
Shishiku"Is there something?"
Hanae"Kutte. Bloody cur."
Shishiku"————"
Shishiku"Your remarks are duly received. Now, kindly get ready."
Hanae"Akal ke dushman. Enemy of your own brain."
Shishiku"..."
Shishiku"When satisfaction has been obtained, kindly proceed to the waiting room. Your attendants are waiting."
Hanae"Tatti."
Shishiku"........................"
Hanae"All this talk, only shit is reaching my ears. Tatti tatti tatti tatti tatti tatti."
Shishiku"You lying little fraud—"
Hanae"...Ghh..."
Shishiku"That low character of yours. Everything else, perhaps, but this I could not beat into shape for you. Usurper's blood will speak, apparently. Your elder sister was just the same."
Shishiku"And this specimen must be put forward as the Great Lord's consort... The Ootori house will carry the shame for a thousand years. Entirely my inadequacy. This Shishiku was not equal to the duty."
Shishiku"For that, Lady Hanae, kindly forgive me."
Hanae"Ghh... ah."
Shishiku"Once our purpose is accomplished... your correction will receive my thorough attention. This time, at least a passing resemblance to a human being I shall obtain."
Hanae"...You...! Chhod... let go, you freak!"
Shishiku"..."
Shishiku"Tch!"

Hanae"..."

Hanae"..."
Shishiku"Escort Lady Hanae."
Ootori Soldier B"Y-yes, sir!"
Ootori Soldier B"Then, my lady, this way..."
